name: offerte-tool
description: Offerte Tool — start backend (Node/Express) en frontend (Vite) samen in één venster.

scripts.postinstall: npm.cmd --prefix backend install && npm.cmd --prefix frontend-vite install
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail --restart-tries 5 --restart-after 1000 "set NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation && npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
